title: Mahjong Kong Pop
description: Combine classic Chinese Mahjong Chow, Pong, and Kong melds with brisk puzzle clearing—build winning hands rapidly for explosive score combos.
controls: Tap Mahjong tiles to assemble valid sequences (Chow), triplets (Pong), or quads (Kong) and clear the table.

zh-CN.title: 麻将吃碰杠
zh-CN.description: 国风创新玩法麻将吃碰杠：把传统麻将吃碰杠胡牌规则融入爽快消除，连杠清屏爆分超刺激！
zh-CN.controls: 点击挑选麻将牌组成顺子吃、刻子碰或四张杠触发消除爆分，清空牌堆通关。
